Quickstart

Point the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK you already use at the router and make a first call.

The router speaks three wire formats: the OpenAI chat completions format, the OpenAI responses format and the Anthropic messages format. You keep your SDK and change two things: the base URL and the key.

What you need

  • A relay key. Today a signed-in workspace creates one on the Keys page of the console. A sign-up that gives a key in one flow is coming (KEY-1b).
  • The base URL: https://relay.massrelay.ai/v1. Staging is https://relay-stag.massrelay.ai/v1.

curl

curl https://relay.massrelay.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hello in one sentence."}]}'

The model field is optional: when it is absent the key's routing picks the model. Every answer carries an id of the form chatcmpl-<decisionId>; keep it, because the explain door reads it back (see Routing).

The OpenAI SDKs

from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://relay.massrelay.ai/v1", api_key="YOUR_RELAY_KEY")
reply = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="MODEL_ID_FROM_GET_V1_MODELS",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence."}],
)
print(reply.choices[0].message.content)

The same base URL serves POST /v1/responses for code written against the responses format.

The Anthropic SDK

import anthropic
client = anthropic.Anthropic(base_url="https://relay.massrelay.ai", api_key="YOUR_RELAY_KEY")
msg = client.messages.create(
    model="MODEL_ID_FROM_GET_V1_MODELS",
    max_tokens=256,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence."}],
)
print(msg.content[0].text)

The SDK appends /v1/messages to the base URL.

Streaming

Set stream to true on any of the three doors. The answer is then a server-sent event stream in the dialect of that door.

The doors of this chapter

POST /v1/chat/completions

Who may call: relay key (bearer).

Request schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct ChatBody in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (for example n, stop, top_p, seed are ignored). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "messages"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "A model id or an alias from GET /v1/models. Optional: the key's routing decides when absent."
    },
    "messages": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true,
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "content": {
            "description": "Text; the gateway reads the text of a message.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "array"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Required and non-empty; an empty or missing list is a 400."
    },
    "max_completion_tokens": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "max_tokens": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "temperature": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "stream": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Default false."
    },
    "tools": {
      "description": "Carried and forwarded verbatim upstream; never validated here.",
      "type": "array"
    },
    "response_format": {
      "description": "Carried and forwarded verbatim upstream.",
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "reasoning_effort": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The o-series field; read as the request's effort."
    }
  }
}

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/object (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct chat_completion_body in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (streaming responses are server-sent events and are not described here). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "object",
    "created",
    "model",
    "choices",
    "usage"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "chatcmpl-<decisionId>; the decision id is the key of GET /v1/route/explain/{decisionId}."
    },
    "object": {
      "const": "chat.completion"
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "choices": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "index": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "message": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "role": {
                "const": "assistant"
              },
              "content": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            }
          },
          "finish_reason": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "usage": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "prompt_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "completion_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "total_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

Every answer carries a decision id; the explain door returns why that model was chosen.

POST /v1/responses

Who may call: relay key (bearer).

Request schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/create (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct ResponsesBody in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (tools and previous_response_id are not read on this surface). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "input"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "input": {
      "description": "Required: a string or a list of {role?, content} items (role defaults to user).",
      "type": [
        "string",
        "array"
      ]
    },
    "instructions": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Becomes a leading system message; blank text contributes nothing."
    },
    "max_output_tokens": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "temperature": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "stream": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "reasoning": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "effort": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "description": "Only reasoning.effort is read."
    }
  }
}

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/object (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct responses_body in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (streaming is not described here). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "object",
    "status",
    "output",
    "output_text",
    "usage"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "resp_<decisionId>"
    },
    "object": {
      "const": "response"
    },
    "created_at": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "status": {
      "const": "completed"
    },
    "output": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "const": "message"
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "role": {
            "const": "assistant"
          },
          "content": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "type": {
                  "const": "output_text"
                },
                "text": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "type": "array"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "output_text": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "usage": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "input_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "output_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "total_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

Every answer carries a decision id; the explain door returns why that model was chosen.

POST /v1/messages

Who may call: relay key (bearer).

Request schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct MessagesBody in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (for example top_p, top_k, stop_sequences, tools are not read on this surface). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "messages"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "messages": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true,
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "content": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "array"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "system": {
      "description": "A string, or a list of {type:text,text} blocks (joined). An empty list contributes nothing.",
      "type": [
        "string",
        "array"
      ]
    },
    "max_tokens": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "temperature": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "stream": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "thinking": {
      "description": "This gateway reads a plain effort string, or an object with an effort field; it does not translate Anthropic's budget_tokens block.",
      "type": [
        "string",
        "object"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct messages_body in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (streaming is not described here). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "type",
    "role",
    "model",
    "content",
    "stop_reason",
    "usage"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "msg_<decisionId>"
    },
    "type": {
      "const": "message"
    },
    "role": {
      "const": "assistant"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "const": "text"
          },
          "text": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "stop_reason": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "stop_sequence": {
      "type": "null"
    },
    "usage": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "input_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "output_tokens": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

Every answer carries a decision id; the explain door returns why that model was chosen.
